name: poker-editor-monorepo
postinstall: npm run build -w @poker/cards-core && npm run build -w @poker/rules-schema

scripts.build: npm run build -w @poker/cards-core && npm run build -w @poker/rules-schema && npm run build -w @poker/web && npm run build -w @poker/game-server
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/web && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:migrate:dev: cd apps/web && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:push: cd apps/web && npx prisma db push
